## ConvertIAsyncEnumerableIntoEnumerable {#Sisk_Core_Http_HttpServerConfiguration_ConvertIAsyncEnumerableIntoEnumerable}

Gets or sets whether the HTTP server should convert [IAsyncEnumerable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.iasyncenumerable) object responses into
an blocking [IEnumerable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ienumerable).
